selection: 17 published examples plus 3 historical bug versions; WTC is a published known-lookahead example. One distinct original source per case. Not a random or production deployment sample.
holdout: Later historical periods frozen before agent execution, never sent to model or used for repair feedback.
repetition_policy: One agent episode per case. Identical native calls reused. Necessary patch/probe/holdout runs counted separately.
scope: Single instrument under explicit native execution and fee profiles; no claim of live profitability or universal correctness.
